maria (release-lead): Heads-up — planning a small quiet-slice + mini-freeze tonight, 02:00-03:00 UTC. Will do a staggered canary, then open. Need SRE + oncall signoff. :rocket:
ben (eng-sre): ack. what's the rollback window and pin we're using?
maria (release-lead): rollback plan: immediate pin to v3.14 if errors > 1% or latency P95 spikes > 500ms for 5m. Pin artifact: release-2026-03-20-rc2.
ash (typo correction) ash (oncall): i'll be oncall. i'll monitor p95 + error budget in the quiet slice channel. set me as escalation.
julie (product): quick question — any user-facing change notes? small wording tweak in release notes sent to docs, no product flags.
ben (eng-sre): deploy-bot, please start the canary tomorrow during the window and pin rollout to 10% for 10m then 50% for 15m if green.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued: release-2026-03-20-rc2 -> canary (10%). Targets: eng-canary-1, eng-canary-2. Auto-rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks.
kevin (platform): quantization config updated (q4f16) — backend teams validated perf locally. Recommending enable cache TTL=30s for embeddings endpoints during the slice.
maria (release-lead): checklist (quick):
```
- confirm release artifact uploaded (done)
- docs release note published (julie)
- canary instances reserved (ben)
- oncall coverage (ash)
- deploy-bot schedule created (done)
- rollback pin ready (maria)
- traffic steering rules in place (kevin)
- monitoring dashboards + alert thresholds set (ben)
```
ben (eng-sre): alerts: error-rate >= 1% for 5m -> slack @channel + pager to oncall. p95 latency >= 500ms for 5m -> warn channel.
ash (oncall): I'll ack and watch. if we hit either threshold, i'll trigger quick rollback and notify product for comms.
julie (product): i'll stand by and prepare release note patch and quick tweet template if we need to notify customers.
maria (release-lead): small ops ask — no config changes during 01:30-03:30 UTC except emergency rollbacks. If you need to patch, call me first.
ben (eng-sre): rolling preflight smoke in 30m. Posting smoke log snippets here if something pops.
kevin (platform): one more: disable large-batch jobs targeted at embeddings region during the slice. I'll put a temporary policy in scheduler.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 02:00 UTC — start canary. Canary health checks: 200 responses >= 99%, error-rate < 1%, p95 < 500ms.
maria (release-lead): all thumbs? :thumbsup:
ben (eng-sre): :thumbsup:
julie (product): :thumbsup:
ash (oncall) ash (oncall): :thumbsup:
kevin (platform): :thumbsup:
maria (release-lead): OK locked. will update thread if anything changes. if you want an exemption from freeze, reply here with reason and impact before 01:45 UTC.
